name: elysia-structured-logger
description: Structured wide-event logging plugin for Elysia applications.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target node --external elysia && bunx tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
